adjudication.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host the code blindly dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] and [:category_id] (no strong params / nil-guard). If params[:embeddable_host] is missing, this will raise NoMethodError. Additionally, #update and #destroy fetch the record via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` without handling not-found; `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` on nil, and `host.destroy` will also raise, producing a 500 instead of a 404/400.
